Do you enjoy working with your hands and are you looking for a varied job in production? Then the position of Assembly Worker at Kingspan in Gemert is perfect for you.

As an assembly worker, you will work on a production line. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that EPS cool boxes are properly glued together. You will work at different stations. 
At one station, you will glue the sides of the cool box, and at the final station, you will assemble the remaining parts.
You are responsible for checking the final product and applying the correct label. After that, you place the order in the warehouse. Together with your team, you ensure that all products meet the required quality standards.

You won’t stay at the same station all the time—you will rotate with your colleagues, which keeps the work varied and interesting.

What we ask from you:

- You have a good command of the Dutch or English language
- Experience is not required; motivation is more important
- You live near Gemert, Helmond, Deurne, Uden, Venray, or Eindhoven

jobs.description:
Will you be driving a reach truck at DHL in Bemmel soon?

Would you like to start in logistics and develop yourself into a reach truck driver? At our new DHL Supply Chain location in Bemmel, we are looking for logistics employees who want to work with a reach truck.

No certificate yet? No problem: DHL will train you internally to become a reach truck driver – fully on the job and at our expense.

What will you do?

- Operating a reach truck to store and retrieve goods, including at height
- Moving pallets and goods throughout the warehouse
- Picking and scanning orders
- Processing incoming and outgoing goods
- Ensuring a clean, safe, and organized workplace

You will work at a location that is continuously developing, where new clients are regularly being onboarded. This means you will constantly learn new processes.

Good to know: working hours

In July, August, and September, we operate three shifts to handle the busy period:

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 08:00 – 17:00
- 15:00 – 24:00

From October onwards, you will switch to regular day shifts (Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00). Your weekends will be free.

Due to the early and late shifts during the first months, own transportation is recommended.

Who are you?

- You are at least 18 years old
- You are eager to learn and want to develop into a reach truck driver
- You work accurately and with a focus on safety
- You are available for 32 to 40 hours per week in day shifts, Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00
- You speak Dutch or English

A reach truck certificate is a plus, but not required, we value motivation and commitment more, and we will provide your internal training at DHL.

Are you someone who likes to keep an overview, values quality, and is not afraid to roll up your sleeves? We are looking for an Operational Support Specialist to strengthen our Warehouse team. In this versatile role, you will support the Warehouse Team Leader in coordinating and monitoring daily operational processes. You will also work hands-on in the operation, helping ensure that activities are carried out safely, efficiently, and on time. Wie zoeken we? MBO-level working and thinking ability (vocational education level); Knowledge of warehouse products, services, and operational processes; Basic knowledge of automated Warehouse Management Systems (WMS); Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Word; Strong communication and interpersonal skills; A proactive and motivating attitude; The ability to set priorities and perform well under time pressure; Good command of Dutch and/or English. For French-speaking locations, proficiency in French and/or English is required; At least 6 months of relevant experience as a Warehouse Operator and/or VAS Operator. A completed vocational qualification is preferred. Wat bieden wij je? We offer a varied position that combines hands-on warehouse activities with responsibility for supporting and coordinating operational processes. You will work closely with the Warehouse Team Leader and your colleagues on the warehouse floor, with opportunities to further develop your skills and experience within the logistics operation. Functieomschrijving As an Operational Support Specialist, you will report directly to the Warehouse Team Leader. Although you will not have formal management responsibilities, you will play an important coordinating and supporting role within the team. You will help the Team Leader achieve operational targets, monitor progress and quality, and act as a point of contact for employees on the warehouse floor. You identify issues, support colleagues, and contribute to the smooth running of daily operations. Your

responsibilities include: Supporting the Team Leader in achieving agreed performance targets; Monitoring and reporting operational results; Acting as a point of contact for employees regarding questions, issues, and operational processes; Coordinating daily activities and supporting the start-up of shifts; Monitoring the progress, quality, and efficiency of warehouse activities; Ensuring compliance with procedures, standards, and safety regulations; Identifying operational issues and opportunities for improvement; Contributing to a positive, safe, and productive working environment; Identifying and reporting bottlenecks in operational processes; Actively participating in warehouse activities, including moving, picking, loading, unloading, and registering goods; Checking goods and responding appropriately to discrepancies or damage; Performing other operational duties in accordance with applicable procedures and guidelines.

Do you enjoy working in a logistics environment and like having a variety of tasks?
For our client in Deurne, we are looking for motivated EPT Operators / Order Pickers.

After enjoying a cup of coffee or tea, you and your colleagues will start the workday. You will be responsible for a variety of tasks within the warehouse, including:

- Picking, checking, collecting, and preparing orders for shipment
- Wrapping and scanning pallets
- Moving goods and pallets using an EPT (Electric Pallet Truck)
- Lifting boxes weighing up to 23 kg
- Operating reach trucks, combi trucks, and forklifts

In addition, you may occasionally be assigned other warehouse-related tasks, such as applying stickers and labels, repacking products, inflating balls, and performing other general warehouse duties.

Who are you?

- You are flexible and do not mind working in a two-shift schedule.
- You live in the region of Deurne, Helmond, Weert, Venray, or Peel en Maas.
- You speak Dutch or English.

As a Reachtruck/or Forklift driver at Samsung SDS in Tilburg, you will make sure that all products get to the right place. You work in a multinational team where you will quickly feel at home.

In the warehouse you are constantly on the move. You load and unload trucks with precision and speed. With your reach truck or forklift you drive through the aisles to pick or put away products. You stack items neatly, so everything is stored efficiently.

Cooperation is important in this job. You consult with colleagues to make sure the work runs smoothly. Together you ensure that all orders are ready for shipment on time.

You work 37.5 hours per week in two shifts: from 06:00 to 14:30 or from 14:30 to 23:00. 

Are you ready to get started in this modern distribution center? Then apply now and become part of the Samsung SDS team!

You enjoy being active and like variety in your work. As a reach truck or forklift driver at Samsung SDS, you'll make sure everything gets to the right place.

What you bring:

- You speak good English. So you can easily communicate with your colleagues.
- You have a good physical condition. The work can be heavy at times.
- You are available full time and can work both shifts 
- You have your own accommodation and transport

It is an advantage if you can also work on weekends. This way you help the team when it is extra busy.

Would you like to work in one of the most advanced high-tech environments in the world? Do you have experience in logistics and enjoy working with precision, quality, and technology? If you are a logistics professional willing to work in 2 shift, please read on and apply! For our client ASML in Veldhoven, we are looking for motivated Warehouse & Cleanroom Operators to support the logistics processes behind the production of cutting-edge semiconductor equipment. This is your opportunity to join a world-leading technology company where innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do. Wie zoeken we? We are looking for candidates who have: MBO Level 3 or 4 education in Logistics or a comparable qualification Affinity with logistics processes and technology At least 2 years of experience in logistics and/or a production environment Experience in a cleanroom environment (preferred) Experience working with quality standards (preferred) Good command of the English language, both spoken and written Basic to intermediate computer skills Experience with SAP is considered an advantage A flexible attitude towards future shift schedule changes In addition, candidates must be able to provide: A valid Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) An EPT certificate A Hoisting & Lifting certificate (training is provided) Wat bieden wij je? We offer an exciting opportunity to grow within a leading high-tech environment where your contribution matters: Gross monthly salary of €3,195 (excluding shift allowance) 25.1% shift allowance for working in a two-shift schedule Working hours: 06:30–15:30 and 15:00–00:00 Travel reimbursement 13th month salary Annual bonus based on company results Long-term career and development opportunities Functieomschrijving As a Warehouse & Cleanroom Operator, you play a vital role in ensuring materials, tools, and components are available at the right place and at the right time. You will work in both warehouse and cleanroom

environments and contribute directly to the efficiency of ASML's production processes. Your responsibilities will include: Issuing and receiving materials, tools, parts, and packaging for internal customers Transporting materials to and from cleanroom cabins Checking materials for quality, completeness, and accuracy Cleaning, packaging, and preparing materials for storage and transportation Picking and preparing orders for internal and external customers Processing logistics data in administrative systems Loading and unloading trucks using an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)

Are you an experienced Reach Truck Driver and comfortable working at height? Then we are looking for you!

For our client in Deurne, we are looking for an experienced High Reach Truck Driver.

After enjoying a cup of coffee or tea, you will start your day with the following tasks:

- Operating a reach truck at heights of up to 12 meters

In addition, you may occasionally be assigned other warehouse-related tasks, such as applying stickers and labels to products, repacking goods, inflating balls, and carrying out other general warehouse duties.

The work is varied and dynamic, ensuring that no two days are the same.

Who are you?

- You are flexible and do not mind working in a two-shift schedule.
- You live in the region of Deurne, Helmond, Weert, Venray, or Peel en Maas.
- You speak Dutch or English.

- Starting salary from €14.99 per hour

- Guaranteed 32 hours per week
